notes.title: Rogue Bots v2.0 update
notes.content:
Got some time to work on addressing some of the issues and content that I wanted to add. This post is an announcement for the same and details the changes made to the game.

Huge thanks to everyone who played the game after its release and gave their feedback.

List of all changes made to the game.
[list]
[*]Added new ability: Cyber Blast.
[*]Added new weapon: Rifle
[*]Added new melee weapon: Axe.
[*]Added new attack for melee.
[*]Added content: 2 new levels.
[*]Added 2 new enemy types: Drones and bots with shield.
[*]Added video tutorials for better explanation of abilities.
[*]Bots now spawn ammo and cells when neutralized.
[*]Power cell now explodes on impact and can be shot only through SX-31.
[*]Power cell explosion no longer neutralizes enemy instantly.
[*]Added Rifle ability: Spawn multiple rifles.
[*]Added SX-31 ability: Shoot power cell.
[*]Added physical animation for bots when hit by rifle bullet.
[*]Changes to particle effects when bot neutralized.
[*]Changes to particle effects when standing near generator.
[*]Changed hit marker when bot neutralized.
[*]Changed look of some levels.
[*]Added sound and particle effects for bot when attacking.
[*]Added weapon switch effects.
[*]Added particle effect for bot when hits ground.
[*]Fixed an issue in one level where bots were able to shoot through walls.
[/list]

Again, it will be beneficial for the game if you can post about any game breaking glitches or bugs you encounter in the game on the forum or send me a mail. I will try to fix them as soon as possible.

Happy gaming!
